For learning to code under ₹80,000 get 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5 or Core i5 chip. You don't need a graphics card, so the money is better spent on the screen, keyboard and battery.

16 GB memory: 8 GB gets slow once you run a browser, an editor and a few tools together.
512 GB SSD: Enough room for projects and tools without clearing space every month.
Screen and keyboard: A 1080p screen and a comfortable keyboard matter more than raw speed.
Battery: Aim for 8 hours or more of real use.

From memory, the lines worth a look are Lenovo IdeaPad Slim and ThinkBook, ASUS Vivobook, HP Pavilion and Acer Swift. A MacBook Air can also fit this budget during sales. I left out prices because they change by seller, so check today's price before you pick.
